title: Bodhi Pakshika Dharma Practice 1
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett recites the Bodhi Paksika Dharma, the 37 Aids to Awakening, as a chanted practice. The recitation opens by venerating the three treasures and vowing to practice the aids with whole hearts, bodies, and minds, day and night. Nomon then names each group in turn: the four foundations of mindfulness (body, sensations and reactions, thoughts and emotions), the four proper exertions, the four bases of freedom, the five wholesome roots, the five strengths, the seven factors of enlightenment, and the noble path of right action, right effort, right mindfulness, and right samadhi. It closes with a dedication of the benefit to all beings in all directions and a wish to enter the fullness of Buddha's way.
